The Vision
More than a conference —
a living movement.
"Where Inner Stillness Meets Global Leadership"

An immersive five-day dialogue bringing together spiritual masters, global CEOs, policy leaders, educators and changemakers to reimagine leadership through the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita.

World Leadership Dialogue 2027 is envisioned as a sacred global gathering where leaders, seekers, educators, entrepreneurs, policy makers, and changemakers come together to explore the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita in the context of modern leadership, ethics, innovation, sustainability, and human flourishing.

Set amidst the serene environment of Chinmaya Vibhooti Vision Centre, the dialogue seeks to create a space where interaction, reflection, silence, and action come together to inspire a new generation of conscious global leadership.

How to Join
Who should
attend?

This gathering is for anyone committed to conscious leadership and a better world.

01

Leaders & Executives

CEOs, directors, and senior professionals seeking wisdom-rooted leadership frameworks for today's complex world.

02

Educators & Academics

Professors, researchers, and institution builders exploring the integration of ancient wisdom with modern pedagogy.

03

Entrepreneurs & Innovators

Founders and changemakers building ventures guided by purpose, ethics, and dharmic principles.

04

Policy Makers

Government leaders and public servants exploring governance rooted in sustainability and human flourishing.

05

Spiritual Seekers

Individuals on a path of self-inquiry and inner growth, seeking community with like-minded leaders worldwide.

06

Youth & Students

The next generation of leaders invited to engage in intergenerational dialogues on ethics, sustainability, and action.

How You Can Contribute
Be part of
this movement.

Participate

Register as a delegate and join the 5-day dialogue. Choose from residential or day-participation options based on your availability.

Sponsor & Partner

Align your organisation with this global movement. Sponsorship opportunities available for institutions, corporates, and foundations.

Seva Involvement

Contribute your time, skills, and energy as a seva volunteer. Special room allotments available for seva participants.

Spread the Word

Share this dialogue with your network. Help build the Global Gita Movement by bringing the right people to the conversation.

About the Event

A Sacred Space for
Conscious Leadership

World Leadership Dialogue 2027 aspires to become more than a conference — a living movement bringing together individuals and institutions committed to building a more compassionate, ethical, and awakened world.

The Vision
Rooted in the
Bhagavad Gita.

World Leadership Dialogue 2027 is envisioned as a sacred global gathering where leaders, seekers, educators, entrepreneurs, policy makers, and changemakers come together to explore the timeless wisdom of the Bhagavad Gita in the context of modern leadership, ethics, innovation, sustainability, and human flourishing.

Set amidst the serene environment of Chinmaya Vibhooti Vision Centre, the dialogue seeks to create a space where interaction, reflection, silence, and action come together to inspire a new generation of conscious global leadership.

More than a conference, the World Leadership Dialogue aspires to become a living movement — bringing together individuals and institutions committed to building a more compassionate, ethical, and awakened world.

Jointly Presented By
SOIL Institute of Management
India's only co-created B-School, integrating wisdom, leadership, and human values.

Event Schedule
5 Days of Wisdom,
Reflection & Action.

A carefully curated journey from arrival to commitment — each day deepening the inquiry.

Day 1
February 4, 2027
Building the Learning Community
Arrival and a quiet orientation walk through the ashram grounds, followed by community-building dialogues in small circles. The inaugural plenary brings blessings from spiritual leaders and the invocation of the Gita, closing with a cultural welcome on India's spiritual diversity.
View schedule →
Day 2
February 5, 2027
The Gita for Well-being & Ethics
Morning prayers and Gita chanting open a day on joyful living. Plenaries explore well-being of mind, body and spirit, and dharma in action, with open-space dialogues on ethics in leadership and an evening of storytelling and music.
View schedule →
Day 3
February 6, 2027
The Gita for Excellence, Productivity & Innovation
A meditation on Yogasthah kuru karmani leads into plenaries on quality and productivity, and on creativity as surrender. Open spaces cover innovation and dharmic productivity, ending in a cultural fusion event and the daily sankalpa.
View schedule →
Day 4
February 7, 2027
The Gita for Sustainability, Diversity & Inclusion
A silent walk in nature begins a day on living in harmony. Plenaries address sustainability and seeing one in all, intergenerational dialogues bring youth and elders together, and folk and world performances close the evening.
View schedule →
Day 5
February 8, 2027
Building the Global Gita Movement
The closing plenary reflects on dharmic leadership for the future and articulates the Global Gita Movement. Partnership roundtables design collaborations across six themes, groups present their action commitments, and the dialogue ends in collective silence.
View schedule →
